functionalRequirement: Faculties shall be able to upload and download assignments, college notices, student notices, journals, and videos.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must support the upload and download of all specified file types (assignments, notices, journals, videos) with a success rate of 100% for valid inputs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive support for multiple file types, necessitating full functional coverage.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must allow file uploads and downloads to complete within 5 seconds for files up to 100 MB in size.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves frequent file transfers, requiring timely performance for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Capacity: The system must support concurrent uploads and downloads by at least 100 users simultaneously without degradation in performance.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR implies usage by multiple faculties, necessitating scalable capacity.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Operability: The system must provide an intuitive interface for file uploads and downloads, with clear progress indicators and error messages for failed operations.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves frequent user interaction, requiring ease of operation.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Availability: The system must be available for file uploads and downloads for 99.9% of the operational time.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR assumes continuous access to file management services, necessitating high availability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Confidentiality: The system must encrypt all file transfers using TLS 1.3 to protect sensitive data.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves handling potentially sensitive documents, requiring secure transmission.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Modifiability: The system must allow for easy addition of new file types for upload and download with minimal code changes.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR may require future expansion to support additional file types, necessitating modifiability.

functionalRequirement: System shall allow users to rate and review services by providing comments on tour plans or services, with comments stored in the database and a thank you message displayed.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Functional Completeness: The system must allow users to submit ratings, reviews, and comments for all specified services with a success rate of 100% for valid inputs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR requires comprehensive support for user feedback, necessitating full functional coverage.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Time Behavior: The system must process and store user ratings, reviews, and comments within 500 milliseconds per submission.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves real-time user interaction, requiring timely processing for usability.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: User Engagement: The system must display a thank you message immediately after a user submits a rating or review, with a response time of less than 200 milliseconds.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR emphasizes user interaction, requiring immediate feedback to enhance engagement.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Fault Tolerance: The system must ensure that no user-submitted ratings, reviews, or comments are lost, even in the event of a temporary database failure.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves critical user-generated content, necessitating fault tolerance.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Integrity: The system must validate and sanitize all user-submitted comments to prevent SQL injection and other malicious inputs.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves storing user-generated content in a database, requiring protection against vulnerabilities.

identifiedNFRs.requirement: Testability: The system must provide automated test cases for the submission, storage, and retrieval of ratings, reviews, and comments.
identifiedNFRs.justification: The FR involves critical functionality, necessitating robust testing mechanisms.
